fusions.name: Staghorn Cut
fusions.desc: A raking strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 40% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Run Aground
fusions.desc: Raises a barbed reef under every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 30 water damage and leaving them [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Snagging Shoal
fusions.desc: Sets down a branching growth for 12 seconds that cuts for 3 damage every second within 3 tiles, each cut with a 35% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Accretion
fusions.desc: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a growth on it, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per growth (218% at full). Unfed, a growth fades every 4 seconds.
